findings.where: section 6 memory knobs / placeholders / r_level4 header; 14.4
findings.summary: 'largest fitting N' undefined for the default DK records; the only threshold (peak <= 46000 MB, unit unstated) is the full RTX 8000 TF budget with no margin for the trainer-vs-measure_level_memory gap (validation fragmentation, DALI) seen in milestone 9, while L4/L2 run under memory growth
findings.fix: define fits(record) := peak <= BUDGET[partition][level] (rtx8000 L4 42000 / L2 41000 in the json's unit, dgx-a100 34000), pick N by it for every record type, GRAD_CKPT=none only if the no-ckpt record fits; smoke gpu_peak must meet the same budget; document TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB=<budget> as first fallback after a post-validation OOM

findings.summary: TASK_RATIO=deform:1 with default DEFORM_START 3000 emits --task-start-step deform:3000, which main.py rejects (no task at 0); dry-run test hides it
findings.fix: task-start flags only when HAS_DEFORM && HAS_LINEAR && DEFORM_START > 0; assert absence in the deform-only dry run

findings.summary: a job dying before creating its run dir is 'not started' and is resubmitted on every submit
findings.fix: submitted (jsonl record) + not in squeue + no run dir => failed ('died before start'), never auto-resubmitted; add test

VAL_GROUP_SIZE = min(16, DEFORM_N_small) fixed for the sweep, or state validation fits at 16 regardless
